thread:
Luis: customer Orbital Analytics says they were double-charged on renewal. They expected PO payment only but we have two invoices: INV-2026-09-001 (PO PO-887) and INV-2026-09-002 (card ****4242) for the same subscription sub_01GzA9. Need quick reversal and a customer note.
Jamie: opening a support case with finance, can you paste the raw invoice/payment timestamps and any webhook logs?
Luis: paste below — webhook delivered twice within ~30s; first created invoice with PO applied, second created card charge. payloads: ```{
  "invoice_id": "INV-2026-09-001",
  "subscription_id": "sub_01GzA9",
  "payment_method": "PO-887",
  "event": "invoice.payment_succeeded"
}
{
  "invoice_id": "INV-2026-09-002",
  "subscription_id": "sub_01GzA9",
  "payment_method": "card_4242",
  "event": "invoice.payment_succeeded"
}```
Luis: our gateway logs show the second webhook was a retry after a 502 from our /webhook endpoint at 2026-09-15T14:32:10Z. idempotency_key not present on second delivery.
Emily: that matches the billing-worker logs — handler returned 500 for the first delivery because the DB transaction timed out when reconciling the PO metadata. Retry created a second invoice because we only dedupe on invoice_id and the payload had different invoice_id (generated by gateway).
Alex: finance confirmed both charges captured. We'll need to refund the card charge and issue a reversal/credit for the PO invoice. Please include internal reason = "duplicate_renewal" and reference to customer request.
Charlie: ops — I see a billing-worker deploy at 2026-09-15T14:30:00Z, which coincides. Short term: I can mark the subscription as paused and prevent any more auto-invoices for this customer. Ops will void the duplicate invoice on our ledger once finance issues the refund.
Jamie: customer wants ETA and that they won't be charged again. I'll tell them we will refund the card within 48 hours and reverse the PO invoice, and that we're pausing auto-renewals for them.
Alex: creating refund now: REF-2026-09-555 (card) and credit note CN-2026-09-12 for the PO invoice. Tagging for approval. @charlie_ops can you approve the ledger reversal? :thumbsup:
Charlie: Approved, proceeding. I'll also add a manual journal entry and mark INV-2026-09-001 as reversed.
Emily: quick mitigation: patch merged that enforces idempotency_key requirement for external payment webhooks and rejects duplicates if invoice_id or subscription_id already reconciled. I'll canary deploy to 2 hosts now.
Luis: thanks — after refunds go through I'll send confirmation to the customer and close the case. Noting follow-up action items: (1) add stronger dedupe on subscription_id+period, (2) add alert for webhook 5xx spikes, (3) postmortem if the deploy correlates.
Stripe Bot: automated — refund REF-2026-09-555 created (status: pending_capture_reversal) 2026-09-15T15:01:10Z.
Jamie: noted, will update Orbital Analytics. cc @alex_finance for final amounts and @emily_engineer for rollout notes. :eyes:
